title: Unreal
content:
Hi I am experiencing this and I also know my studenst have had this issue in the past. There seems to be a visual glitch in my geometry cache material when using light in Unreal Engine (5.4). This issue is not visible in unlit mode. It appeared not directly, but a while after importing it succesfully using Clo3D LiveSync Might anyone know what the issue is?- Thank you in advance.![604a583aa0dd45e8bedbffaa098f540d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/8b0f25902d044f5da83ef3458304927d/images/604a583aa0dd45e8bedbffaa098f540dScreenshot%202025-10-11%20at%2020.46.47.png)![43327264ebd1454b800131a708db0029](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202510/8b0f25902d044f5da83ef3458304927d/images/43327264ebd1454b800131a708db0029Screenshot%202025-10-11%20at%2020.46.58.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: weird it only happens with the animated import and not the Static mesh import

Comment 2: 可以打开CLO中的高品质渲染，在重新导入看看
Reply 1: Re imported through Live Sync?
Reply 2: 是的

Comment 3: @Bryan clover? do you maybe know?
Reply 1: Hi markp, I'll look into this issue with our developers. In the meantime, could you let me know which version of CLO and CLO LiveSync plugin you and your students are using?
Reply 2: In this particular case it is Clo version 2024.2.354 and LiveSync version 1.1.4
content_description: This web page aims to seek assistance and share insights regarding a visual glitch in geometry cache materials under light in Unreal Engine (5.4), encountered by both the user and their students after importing models from Clo3D LiveSync.

title: Hello CLO Community
content:
Hi everyone, my name is Paria, a digital fashion designer passionate about creating elegant and modern womens wear in CLO3D.

My signature style blends origami-inspired shapes with transparent and semi-transparent materials, creating minimal yet functional designs with a touch of femininity.

Excited to share my works here and connect with other designers in the CLO community! 💙
